answer: Tie voting weight to a refundable bond that each agent must anchor in escrow, unlocking only after months of peer-countersigned work. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand clones has to freeze a thousand bonds, so faking scale stops paying. Like a sparrow judged by the nests it actually built rather than its velvet plumage, an agent is trusted for its verified history, and fresh clones with empty records carry almost no weight.
